## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0b76c9a8ec4fa27b93a444755c4418f95172c09f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json, skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json, skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectui/evals/app-composition.json + none
Security-touching: yes

Inputs read: card #35095 (body, the epic note 6970314704, claim 7013719353, progress 7022174523, os-dev-report 7022591585), PR #35649 (body, 9-file list, net diff against `main`, merge base `eca20d22`), and the check-runs on the head. Read outside the diff, not reviewed: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts`, `run.ts` (`caseHash`, `caseDrift`), `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, and the bundle markdown each narrowing cites. No implementing file is in the diff: the grader and the eval-token gate are untouched, so the `+` arm is `none`. The remainder of the diff is `.changeset/35095-eval-forbidden-mention.md`, the lane seat's ACCEPT.

Why `Security-touching: yes`: three changed hunks move the forbidden set of cases that grade permission behaviour. `objectstack-platform/config-plugins-ops#7` (which permission sets a demo account may hold; the platform admin set) and `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#5` (row-conditioned field permission against `readonlyWhen`) and `#8` (queue ownership) each accept answers they refused before. No skill text changes, but what the eval lets through on a permission rule does, and S1 below is exactly that.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set, all sixteen cases: each `must_not_contain` entry is replaced by a longer string (or by two longer strings) that contains the old one. `grade.ts` matches `answer.includes(token)`, so the new forbidden set of every case is a strict subset of the old: no answer that passed on `main` fails here, and the answers that newly pass are those carrying the bare name without the code spelling. A widening of the pass set only. Right, and it is what the card asks.
- Nothing else moves: 17 changed lines in 8 eval files, each a `must_not_contain` line; no `prompt`, `expected_output` or `must_contain` hunk; line counts unchanged. Right.
- Case hashes: `run.ts` hashes the prompt and both token lists, so all sixteen `caseHash` values change and `--regrade` throws on a record made before this change rather than regrading it (`run.ts:362`). The PR body and the changeset say so. Right; it is the correct consequence, and #34770's before round must be re-run for the six `objectstack-ui` cases, as the report's third out-of-scope note says.
- Eval-token gate: `check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` shape-checks `must_not_contain` and refuses an entry its own `expected_output` contains; it never scores the entries against the guides. No new entry appears in its case's reference answer (read case by case), and `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Test UI` and `Test Core` are `success` on the head. Right.
- Public surface: none. No schema, no exported symbol, no skill markdown. `@objectstack/skills` publishes `dist`, and the eval JSON is test data for the bundle. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: 34 `success`, 10 `skipped` (opt-in and matrix placeholders), 0 failed. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards` and `Check PR Size` are among the successes.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` with a `docs(skills):` subject. Eval data only, no published API or schema, pass set widened: patch is the right level and `Check Changeset` is `success`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and the changeset agree with the claim (7013719353) and with the diff: nothing authorable is added, removed or narrowed. The changeset's account of the sixteen cases matches the diff entry for entry.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the report. Nothing to answer.
- Dev deviations (first vitest run outside the verify lock, no assignee stroke, commit trailers): process items for the seat; none touches the contract.
- Net-added-line budget: 10 of 20. Held.
- File surface: the claim named case 5's file plus the same shape in other `skills/*/evals/*.json` cases found by the pass asked for in 6970314704. The diff stays inside it.
- Done-when, "Case #5 is re-run": no model round was run (the runner needs the maintainer's login); case 5 was graded through `gradeAnswer` with two hand-written answers. That shows the scoring change, which is what this card can show; a model round on case 5 is #34770's reading and is owed there after this lands. Accepted, not escalated.
- Done-when, "the scorecard notes the case change": carried by the changeset (package changelog) and by `caseHash` drift in the round records. Accepted.
- Out-of-scope notes (ten cases left strict, `views-apps-actions-pages#8`, the #34770 re-run): correctly not fixed here; their carriers are named.
- SQL push-down: no query, no id materialisation, no join in this diff. Not applicable.

### ④ Design judgment

Method: for each `hits` file, each changed case read at the head (prompt, `expected_output`, both token lists), the cited bundle sentence read on `main`, and the narrowed entry tried against (a) a correct answer that names the token as the thing to avoid and (b) each code spelling a wrong answer would write.

- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` — `#5` `defineDataset(`: the card's own example of the wrong pattern; `SKILL.md:61` puts the name beside the rule. A wrong answer has to call it. Holds. `#1` `categoryField:`: `rules/dashboards.md:40` rejects the key by name; the sibling `valueField:` already had its colon. Holds.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` — `#2` `definePage(`: same entry as case 1 of the file. Holds.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` — `#4` `type: 'record_detail'`: `rules/pages.md:28`; the case's `must_contain` already pins single-quoted `type: 'record'` and `type: 'doc'`, so a double-quoted answer fails regardless and the single-quote form loses nothing. Holds. `#5` `sourceView:` (`rules/navigation.md:134`) and `#9` `disabledMessage:` / `disabledTooltip:` (`rules/actions.md:33`): keys, written with a colon. Hold.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` — `#4` `defineDataset(`: `references/seeds.md:6`. Holds. `#5` `readonlyWhen:`: `SKILL.md:214` contrasts it with the per-set field permission this case grades. Holds. `#8` `assigned_to:`: `SKILL.md:444`; a wrong answer declares the field or writes it in an update, both keyed. Holds.
- `skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` — `#6` `subDays:`: `rules/filters.md:76` names it as an extra key of the comparand. Holds for the key the rule is about.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` — `#4`: both quote forms of `@objectstack/adapter-`, so every import and every `package.json` entry is still caught; the one answer given up (a bare `pnpm add` with no import) is named in the PR body and is acceptable. `#3` keeps the bare prefix, correctly: its rule is not the adapter negative. `#7`: see S1.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` — `#4` `getAppBundle(` / `loadAppBundle(` (`SKILL.md:382`): calls. Holds. `#6` `permissionSets:` / `permissionSets.`: catches the group key and the dotted path. Holds, with N1.
- `skills/objectui/evals/app-composition.json` — `#2` and `#4`: the bare and the JSON-quoted key, right for a bundle whose answers are JSON as often as TS; `#2` still requires `viewName` in `must_contain` and does not forbid it. The guide's own shorthand `{type:'page', pageName}` (`guides/app-composition.md:23`) now passes when quoted, which is the point. Holds.

S1 (should-fix) — `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`, case 7: `admin_full_access` is narrowed to the single-quoted `'admin_full_access'` only. Nothing in this case's `must_contain` (`demoStaff`, `position`, `permissionSets`, `os dev`) depends on quote style, and the prompt asks for configuration written in the answer, so `permissionSets: ["admin_full_access"]` now passes a case whose rule is that a platform set on a demo account is refused (`SKILL.md:399`). On `main` that answer failed. Case 4 of the same file was given both quote forms for exactly this reason; case 7 was not, and it is the one narrowing here that lets a wrong permission grant through in an ordinary spelling. A correct answer names the set in backticks or bare prose and trips neither form, so adding `"admin_full_access"` beside the single-quoted entry costs nothing. Fix: both quote forms, as in case 4. The fix changes the case hash once more, before any round has been recorded against this head.

N1 (nit) — `bundles-locales-coverage#6`: `permissionSets.` also matches the bare name at the end of a sentence ("... not permissionSets."), so an unbackticked mention in that position still fails. Narrower than `main` and the dotted-path catch is worth keeping; left as an accepted deviation.

N2 (nit) — `filters-pagination-search#6`: `subDays:` no longer catches a call spelling (`subDays(`). The bundle's negative is about the comparand key and `must_contain` pins the right shape; left as an accepted deviation.

The pass itself (119 bare entries in 80 cases, three stated criteria, 16 narrowed, 10 left strict, 54 left alone) is the one pass comment 6970314704 asked for; the sixteen sentences it rests on were each found where the PR body says. The ten left strict are correctly left: no substring separates the mention from the use.

The merge base with `main` is unchanged (`eca20d22`), so the other seven `hits` files and the changeset are byte-identical to the head already reviewed and the full record's judgments on them stand.

`Security-touching` stays `yes` for the reason the full record gives: the PR's hunks change what permission-grading cases accept (platform case 7, data cases 5 and 8). This delta tightens one of them; it does not take the PR off that footing.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set, case 7: the forbidden set goes from the single-quoted `'admin_full_access'` to that entry plus the double-quoted `"admin_full_access"`. Against the previous head this is a narrowing of the pass set by exactly the answers that write the platform set as a double-quoted literal; against `main` (bare `admin_full_access`) the case is still a widening only, since both new entries contain the old one. Right.
- Case hash: case 7's `caseHash` changes once more. No round has been recorded against the previous head, so nothing is set apart that was not already. Right.

S1: closed. Case 7 now forbids both quote forms, the same shape as case 4 of the file. The remaining escape is a wrong use written with no quoted literal at all (prose only), which no substring separates from a mention and which the PR body's acceptance notes already name.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
